source.title: WAC Leader Announcement (July 2022)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new WAC Leader. **Ekaterina Kaneva will become the new Leader of the WCA Advisory Council (WAC)**. Ekaterina was already working as a member of the WAC.

Ekaterina was selected by the WCA Board, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2021.0%20-%20Councils.pdf) about WCA Councils.

We wish Ekaterina best of luck in fulfilling her new duties.

The new Leader is already promoted. Ekaterina was among two applicants we had and both candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1pJfcb4mPk2i6Mhtm5NNlMcAPP-JvARPE?usp=sharing) if you are interested in viewing them.

List of the other candidates who applied: Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar

translation.title: WCA 顾问理事会负责人任命公告（2022 年 7 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴宣布，**Ekaterina Kaneva 将出任 WCA 顾问理事会（WAC）负责人**。Ekaterina 此前已是 WAC 成员。

WCA 董事会依照关于理事会的[决议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2021.0%20-%20Councils.pdf)第 4 节，选定了 Ekaterina。

祝 Ekaterina 在新岗位上一切顺利。

新负责人现已就任。本次共收到两份申请，Ekaterina 是其中一位申请人。两份申请材料均可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1pJfcb4mPk2i6Mhtm5NNlMcAPP-JvARPE?usp=sharing)查看。

另一位申请人是 Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar。
